purpose: prints a verb's syntax as JSON, and judges its header's discipline

--check.description: prints no JSON; reports each usage line that does not parse and each argument the header does not describe, and fails when there is any

--choices.description: prints the choices of that argument instead, one per line, tab-separated: the value, its description, its state (active, excluded, or none), and the line the verb would print about it given the answers; closed when they are the only values the verb accepts, open when they are suggestions and any value is still allowed

<answer>.description: an argument answered already, as <package>=house or --rule=markdown, since a list may depend on it; an answer that starts with - follows a --

--extend.description: prints instead the arguments the verb learns from the answers, as an object of arguments entries marked extended, for a form to add as fields; kit new answers with the holes of the template the answers name, and {} before it knows

<verb>.description: the verbs to print; one prints its object, several print an array, and none prints every verb
